description: This file is the __init__.py for the torch.distributed._shard.sharded_tensor module, defining functions and hooks for creating, managing, and customizing sharded tensors in PyTorch's distributed framework.

classes.name: ShardedTensor
classes.description: Main class representing a tensor sharded across multiple devices in distributed training.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Represents a local shard of a sharded tensor.

classes.name: ShardedTensorBase
classes.description: Base class for sharded tensor implementations.

classes.name: ShardedTensorMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata information for sharded tensors.

classes.name: ShardMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing a shard's shape, offset, and placement.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized sharded tensor according to the sharding spec and size.

methods.name: ones
methods.description: Creates a sharded tensor filled with ones.

methods.name: zeros
methods.description: Creates a sharded tensor filled with zeros.

methods.name: full
methods.description: Creates a sharded tensor filled with a specified fill value.

methods.name: rand
methods.description: Creates a sharded tensor with random values from a uniform distribution [0, 1).

methods.name: randn
methods.description: Creates a sharded tensor with random values from a normal distribution (mean=0, std=1).

methods.name: init_from_local_shards
methods.description: Constructs a sharded tensor from local shard data and global size.

methods.name: state_dict_hook
methods.description: Hook to add sharded tensors to a module's state_dict.

methods.name: pre_load_state_dict_hook
methods.description: Hook to load sharded tensors from a state_dict into a module.

methods.name: custom_sharded_op_impl
methods.description: Decorator to define custom sharded tensor operations.

methods.name: _sharded_op_impl
methods.description: Decorator to register default sharded tensor operations.
